title: Workflow Frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter in every <workflows_dir>/<id>.md file. Workflows answer 'how do I execute Y' — they are procedural and distinct from concepts which answer 'what is X'.

id.description: Snake_case ID used as the filename and in [[wikilinks]]

description.description: One-sentence plain-English summary of what this workflow accomplishes

status.description: Lifecycle state — 'draft' = steps not yet complete; 'ready' = steps verified; 'deprecated' = superseded or outdated

concepts.description: [[wikilink]] references to concept nodes this workflow touches

tools.description: [[wikilink]] references to tool nodes used in this workflow

related_workflows.description: [[wikilink]] references to workflows that are related, sequential, or alternative

sources.description: [[wikilink]] references to source nodes that informed this workflow

estimated_time.description: Rough time to complete one run of this workflow (e.g. '30 min', '2–4 hours')

created_at.description: ISO date when this workflow was first created (YYYY-MM-DD)

last_updated.description: ISO date of last edit to steps or frontmatter
